core_user: Adults with ADHD, remote workers, students and knowledge workers who need friction-free focus sessions
core_job: Start a timed focus session and avoid phone distraction until the timer ends

acquisition_summary.lower_bound_month9_note: At the lower-bound organic ramp (~4,000 installs/month at Month 9), Month-9 net contribution falls to ~$1,208 and the $2,000 target is not met.

portfolio_contribution: Timer engine reusable for I04 Routine Clock
structural_wedge: Forest and Focus To-Do are locked into ads+IAP feature bloat (gamification, task management, Gantt, wearables) and cannot strip down to a no-account, ad-light, adult/ADHD-focused timer without cannibalizing premium revenue. Focus Loop captures the segment that finds Forest's tree metaphor childish and Focus To-Do bloated.
critical_assumption: Users accept an interstitial at the end of a 25-minute focus session and the widget drives enough daily returns to sustain 20 active days/month.
evidence_that_could_reverse_decision: Real ad-network fill rate in Tier-1 productivity traffic is materially below the Playwire public benchmarks used in the model.
iOS ATT opt-in is so low that ad attribution and eCPM collapse, or Android AccessibilityService app-blocking is rejected by Play Store.
ASO ranking for 'pomodoro timer' / 'adhd focus app' requires >50k reviews to reach top 10, which is not achievable organically within 9 months.
If the organic install ramp reaches only the lower bound (4,000 installs/month at Month 9), the Month-9 net contribution drops to ~$1,208 and the $2,000 target is not met.
mvp_scope: One core job: start a 25-minute focus timer with break reminders
Must-have: local notifications, home-screen widget, session/break/streak log
Ad placements: interstitial at session completion, rewarded video for theme unlock, small banner on setup screen
No account required; optional Android AccessibilityService app-blocking
Analytics: D1/D7/D30, active days, sessions per day, ad impressions/revenue
validation_metrics: D1 retention >= 50%, D7 retention >= 45%, D30 retention >= 42% (classic day-based cohort)
Month-1 (install-month) active fraction >= 70%, Month-2 >= 42%, Month-3 >= 28% (month-cohort, from inputs.json)
Rank in top 15 for 'pomodoro timer' or top 5 for 'adhd focus app' within 9 months
Ad ARPU within +/-20% of $0.23 by Month 6
kill_criteria: Base-case Month-9 Net Monthly Contribution < $2,000 after launch
Build takes >8 weeks or app is rejected from either store for policy reasons
Real ad fill / ATT impact drives ad ARPU below $0.15 at Month 6
Cannot rank in top 20 for a primary head or long-tail keyword by Month 6
D30 retention < 35% or D7 retention < 30% at Month 3
unknowns: Actual ad-network fill rates in Tier-1 productivity traffic post-ATT.
iOS ATT opt-in rate and its effect on ad attribution/eCPM.
Android AccessibilityService approval and Play Store policy for app blocking.
Organic ASO velocity and review-rate needed to rank for 'pomodoro timer' variants.

At the lower-bound organic ramp (~4,000 installs/month at Month 9), Month-9 net contribution falls to approximately $1,208 and the $2,000 target is not met; the base or upper install path is required to clear the gate.
